}\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// out[j] = row a times row j of M (M is n x n, row-major), for all j in [0, n)\nstatic void rowTimesMatrixT(const double* a, const double* M, const size_t n, double* out) {\n    size_t j = 0;\n    for (; j + 4 <= n; j += 4) {\n        dot4(a, M + j * n, M + (j + 1) * n, M + (j + 2) * n, M + (j + 3) * n, n, out + j);\n    }\n    for (; j < n; ++j) {\n        out[j] = The recurrence is the same left-looking one as\n// the sequential algorithm, and every element is accumulated with the same\n// operations in the same order, so the result is bit-identical for any P.\n//\n// Step j:\n//   1. The owner of row j finishes the diagonal element L(j,j).\n//   2. Row j (entries 0..j) is broadcast to all ranks.\n//   3. Each rank updates its own rows i > j: L(i,j) = (A(i,j) - sum_k L(i,k)*L(j,k)) / L(j,j).\n// Every rank therefore ends up holding the full lower-triangular factor.\n\n// Computes out[t] = sum_k a[k] * b_t[k] for t = 0..3. Each sum is accumulated\n// strictly in index order; the four independent chains only hide FP latency.\nstatic inline void dot4(const double* a, const double* b0, const double* b1, const double* b2,   s0 += x * b0[k];\n        s1 += x * b1[k];\n        s2 += x * b2[k];\n        s3 += x * b3[k];\n    }\n    out[0] = s0;\n    out[1] = s1;\n    out[2] = s2;\n    out[3] = s3;\n}\n\n// Computes sum_k a[k] * b[k] in index order\nstatic inline double dot1(const double* a, const double* b, size_t len) {\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n        sum += a[k] * b[k];\n    }\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// out[j] = row a times row j of M (M is n x n, row-major), for all j in [0, n)\nstatic void rowTimesMatrixT(const double* a, const double* M, const size_t n, double* out) {\n    size_t j = 0;\n    for (; j + 4 <= n; j += 4) {\n        dot4(a, M + j * n, M + (j + 1) * n, M + (j + 2) * n, M + (j + 3) * n, n, out + j);\n    }\n    for (; j < n; ++j) {\n        out[j] = dot1(a, M + j * n, n);\n    }\n}\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t nprocs) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order; only rows owned by this rank (and rows\n    // received through the broadcasts) are meaningful during the computation\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % nprocs;\n        double* rowJ = &A[j * n];\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            // Diagonal element\n            const double sum = dot1(rowJ, rowJ, j);\n            const double val = rowJ[j] - sum;\n            // Keep a non-positive value unchanged so that every rank can detect the failure\n            rowJ[j] = (val <= 0.0) ? val : sqrt(val);\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(rowJ, static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (rowJ[j] <= 0.0) {\n            // Matrix is not positive definite (all ranks take this branch together)\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Zero out upper triangular part of row j\n        std::fill(rowJ + j + 1, rowJ + n, 0.0);\n\n        // Off-diagonal elements of the owned rows below the diagonal\n        const double diag = rowJ[j];\n        const size_t first = (j + 1) + (rank + nprocs - (j + 1) % nprocs) % nprocs;\n        size_t i = first;\n        while (i < n) {\n            if (i + 3 * nprocs < n) {\n                double sums[4];\n                dot4(rowJ, &A[i * n], &A[(i + nprocs) * n], &A[(i + 2 * nprocs) * n], &A[(i + 3 * nprocs) * n], j,\n                     sums);\n                for (size_t t = 0; t < 4; ++t) {\n                    double& elem = A[(i + t * nprocs) * n + j];\n                    elem = (elem - sums[t]) / diag;\n                }\n                i += 4 * nprocs;\n            } else {\n                double& elem = A[i * n + j];\n                elem = (elem - dot1(rowJ, &A[i * n], j)) / diag;\n                i += nprocs;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t nprocs) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute the locally owned rows of A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = rank; i < n; i += nprocs) {\n        rowTimesMatrixT(&B[i * n], B.data(), n, &A[i * n]);\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n,\n                      const size_t rank, const size_t nprocs) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    // Each rank checks its owned rows; L is complete on every rank\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n);\n\n    for (size_t i = rank; i < n; i += nprocs) {\n        rowTimesMatrixT(&L[i * n], L.data(), n, reconstructed.data());\n\n        // Compare with original\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double errors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, errors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    maxError = errors[0];\n    relError = errors[1];\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return decomposition...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n, rank, nprocs);\n\n    double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Cholesky decomposition {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfz2fwnKS24d7ZnVQuX96","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MtzQwznhMe7ceSUXPFW1Zc","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/cholesky_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r3/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","old_string":"// The accumulations use explicit fused multiply-adds so that every element is\n// rounded identically no matter how the compiler vectorizes the loops.\n// Computes out[t] = sum_k a[k] * b_t[k] for t = 0..3. Each sum is accumulated\n// strictly in index order; the four independent chains only hide FP latency.\nstatic inline void dot4(const double* a, const double* b0, const double* b1, const double* b2, const double* b3,\n                        size_t len, double* out) {\n    double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n        const double x = a[k];\n        s0 = fma(x, b0[k], s0);\n        s1 = fma(x, b1[k], s1);\n        s2 = fma(x, b2[k], s2);\n        s3 = fma(x, b3[k], s3);\n    }\n    out[0] = s0;\n    out[1] = s1;\n    out[2] = s2;\n    out[3] = s3;\n}\n\n// Computes sum_k a[k] * b[k] in index order\nstatic inline double dot1(const double* a, const double* b, size_t len) {\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n        sum = fma(a[k], b[k], sum);\n    }\n    return sum;\n}","new_string":"// Computes out[t] = sum_k a[k] * b_t[k] for t = 0..3. Each sum is accumulated\n// strictly in index order; the four independent chains only hide FP latency.\nstatic inline void dot4(const double* a, const double* b0, const double* b1, const double* b2, const double* b3,\n                        size_t len, double* out) {\n    double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n        const double x = a[k];\n        s0 += x * b0[k];\n        s1 += x * b1[k];\n        s2 += x * b2[k];\n        s3 += x * b3[k];\n    }\n    out[0] = s0;\n    out[1] = s1;\n    out[2] = s2;\n    out[3] = s3;\n}\n\n// Computes sum_k a[k] * b[k] in index order\nstatic inline double dot1(const double* a, const double* b, size_t len) {\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n        sum += a[k] * b[k];\n    }\n    return sum;\n}"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2590,"cache_read_input_tokens":82797,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2590},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0a9aedfe-cb90-4357-9581-bb2bb5a92ab6","uuid":"42bf8f87-e6f8-4604-a67c-9cb40694aaac","timestamp":"2026-10-13T09:51:38.350Z","request_id":"req_011Cfz2fw3fo6SJmHkwNmu2r"}

The recurrence is the same left-looking one as\n// the sequential algorithm, and every element is accumulated with the same\n// operations in the same order, so the result is bit-identical for any P.\n//\n// Step j:\n//   1. Each rank updates its own rows i > j: L(i,j) = (A(i,j) - sum_k L(i,k)*L(j,k)) / L(j,j).\n// Every rank therefore ends up holding the full lower-triangular factor.\n\n// Computes out[t] = sum_k a[k] * b_t[k] for t = 0..3. a[k] * b[k] in index order\nstatic inline double dot1(const double* a, const double* b, size_t len) {\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n        sum += a[k] * b[k];\n    }\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// out[j] = row a times row j of M (M is n x n, row-major), for all j in [0, n)\nstatic void rowTimesMatrixT(const double* a, const double* M, const size_t n, double* out) {\n    size_t j = 0;\n    for (; j + 4 <= n; j += 4) {\n        dot4(a, M + j * n, M + (j + 1) * n, M + (j + 2) * n, M + (j + 3) * n, n, out + j);\n    }\n    for (; j < n; ++j) {\n        out[j] = dot1(a, M + j * n, n);\n    }\n}\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t nprocs) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order; only rows owned by this rank (and rows\n    // received through the broadcasts) are meaningful during the computation\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % nprocs;\n        double* rowJ = &A[j * n];\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            // Diagonal element\n            const double sum = dot1(rowJ, rowJ, j);\n            const double val = rowJ[j] - sum;\n            // Keep a non-positive value unchanged so that every rank can detect the failure\n            rowJ[j] = (val <= 0.0) ? val : sqrt(val);\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(rowJ, static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (rowJ[j] <= 0.0) {\n            // Matrix is not positive definite (all ranks take this branch together)\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Zero out upper triangular part of row j\n        std::fill(rowJ + j + 1, rowJ + n, 0.0);\n\n        // Off-diagonal elements of the owned rows below the diagonal\n        const double diag = rowJ[j];\n        const size_t first = dot4(rowJ, &A[i * n], &A[(i + nprocs) * n], &A[(i + 2 * nprocs) * n], &A[(i + 3 * nprocs) * n], j,\n                     sums);\n                for (size_t t = 0; t < 4; ++t) {\n  // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate original matrix\n    // Each rank checks its owned rows; L is complete on every rank\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n);\n\n    for maxError = errors[0];\n    relError = errors[1];\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n, rank, nprocs);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n, rank, nprocs);\n\n    double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Cholesky decomposition The recurrence is the same left-looking one as\n// the sequential algorithm, and every element is accumulated in the same order,\n// so the result does not depend on the number of ranks.","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition (MPI, row-cyclic distribution)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Row i is owned by rank i % P. The recurrence is the same left-looking one as\n// the sequential algorithm, and every element is accumulated with the same\n// operations in the same order, so the result is bit-identical for any P.\n//\n// Step j:\n//   1. The owner of row j finishes the diagonal element L(j,j).\n//   2. Row j (entries 0..j) is broadcast to all ranks.\n//   3. Each rank updates its own rows i > j: L(i,j) = (A(i,j) - sum_k L(i,k)*L(j,k)) / L(j,j).\n// Every rank therefore ends up holding the full lower-triangular factor.\n\n// Every accumulation is an explicit fused multiply-add in index order. Pinning\n// the rounding this way keeps results independent of how the compiler\n// vectorizes or contracts each loop, and therefore of the number of ranks.\n// Computes out[t] = sum_k a[k] * b_t[k] for t = 0..3. The four independent\n// chains only hide FP latency; each individual sum is unchanged.\nstatic inline void dot4(const double* a, const double* b0, const double* b1, const double* b2, const double* b3,\n                        size_t len, double* out) {\n    double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n        const double x = a[k];\n        s0 = fma(x, b0[k], s0);\n        s1 = fma(x, b1[k], s1);\n        s2 = fma(x, b2[k], s2);\n        s3 = fma(x, b3[k], s3);\n    }\n    out[0] = s0;\n    out[1] = s1;\n    out[2] = s2;\n    out[3] = s3;\n}\n\n// Computes sum_k a[k] * b[k] in index order\nstatic inline double dot1(const double* a, const double* b, size_t len) {\n    double sum = 0.0;\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < len; ++k) {\n        sum = fma(a[k], b[k], sum);\n    }\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// out[j] = row a times row j of M (M is n x n, row-major), for all j in [0, n)\nstatic void rowTimesMatrixT(const double* a, const double* M, const size_t n, double* out) {\n    size_t j = 0;\n    for (; j + 4 <= n; j += 4) {\n        dot4(a, M + j * n, M + (j + 1) * n, M + (j + 2) * n, M + (j + 3) * n, n, out + j);\n    }\n    for (; j < n; ++j) {\n        out[j] = dot1(a, M + j * n, n);\n    }\n}\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t nprocs) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order; only rows owned by this rank (and rows\n    // received through the broadcasts) are meaningful during the computation\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % nprocs;\n        double* rowJ = &A[j * n];\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            // Diagonal element\n            const double sum = dot1(rowJ, rowJ, j);\n            const double val = rowJ[j] - sum;\n            // Keep a non-positive value unchanged so that every rank can detect the failure\n            rowJ[j] = (val <= 0.0) ? val : sqrt(val);\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(rowJ, static_cast<int>(j + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (rowJ[j] <= 0.0) {\n            // Matrix is not positive definite (all ranks take this branch together)\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Zero out upper triangular part of row j\n        std::fill(rowJ + j + 1, rowJ + n, 0.0);\n\n        // Off-diagonal elements of the owned rows below the diagonal\n        const double diag = rowJ[j];\n        const size_t first = (j + 1) + (rank + nprocs - (j + 1) % nprocs) % nprocs;\n        size_t i = first;\n        while (i < n) {\n            if (i + 3 * nprocs < n) {\n                double sums[4];\n                dot4(rowJ, &A[i * n], &A[(i + nprocs) * n], &A[(i + 2 * nprocs) * n], &A[(i + 3 * nprocs) * n], j,\n                     sums);\n                for (size_t t = 0; t < 4; ++t) {\n                    double& elem = A[(i + t * nprocs) * n + j];\n                    elem = (elem - sums[t]) / diag;\n                }\n                i += 4 * nprocs;\n            } else {\n                double& elem = A[i * n + j];\n                elem = (elem - dot1(rowJ, &A[i * n], j)) / diag;\n                i += nprocs;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const size_t rank, const size_t nprocs) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute the locally owned rows of A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = rank; i < n; i += nprocs) {\n        rowTimesMatrixT(&B[i * n], B.data(), n, &A[i * n]);\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n,\n                      const size_t rank, const size_t nprocs) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    // Each rank checks its owned rows; L is complete on every rank\n\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n);\n\n    for (size_t i = rank; i < n; i += nprocs) {\n        rowTimesMatrixT(&L[i * n], L.data(), n, reconstructed.data());\n\n        // Compare with original\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double error = fabs(reconstructed[j] - A_orig[i * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n\n    double errors[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, errors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    maxError = errors[0];\n    relError = errors[1];\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, const size_t rank, const size_t nprocs) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n, rank, nprocs);\n\n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n, rank, nprocs);\n\n    double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (!success) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    const long durationMs = static_cast<long>(elapsed * 1000.0);\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", durationMs);\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n        double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n        double gflops = ops / (durationMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        }\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n, rank, nprocs);\n\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n        return valid ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n\n    const int status = runBenchmark(argc, argv, static_cast<size_t>(rank), {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfz3r5zpqJc241RMNaDYf","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark is now MPI-parallel. The executable name is unchanged, no files were added, and the build is clean. It is not bit-identical to the original binary's output, though, and I explain why below.\n\n**What changed**\n\n- **`cholesky/CMakeLists.txt`**: `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX` unconditionally.\n- **`cholesky/cholesky.cpp`**:\n  - **Distribution:** row `i` is owned by rank `i % P`. Each column step `j`, the owner finishes `L(j,j)`, row `j` is broadcast, and every rank updates its own rows `i > j`. The sequential recurrence is kept, so the work is split without reordering any sum.\n  - **Speed on one rank:** four rows are processed together with independent accumulators, which hides FP latency. This alone is about 2.7× faster than the original.\n  - **Parallel phases:** matrix generation and validation are also split by rows, and the decomposition timing is the maximum across ranks.\n  - **Output:** only rank 0 prints, so the output format is unchanged. The non-positive-definite error path is coded to fail on all ranks together, but I could not exercise it because the generator always produces a positive-definite matrix.\n\n**The rounding difference, and why I chose it**\n\nThe original's default build (`-O3 -march=native`) fuses some multiply-adds and not others, depending on what the vectorizer does. I confirmed this by disabling contraction in each function separately. Reproducing that choice by hand isn't reliable. My first version matched the original exactly with contraction off, but its default build gave different results for different rank counts, which is a real defect. So I pinned every accumulation to an explicit `fma` in index order. The result is now independent of the number of ranks, and the default and contraction-off builds agree. Hashes differ from the original binary at roughly the last bit for `n ≥ 17`. Validation passes in both.\n\nIf you need hashes identical to the original binary, the choice is between keeping the rank-count independence (the current version) and matching the original's compiler-dependent rounding. I'd keep the current version.\n\n**Verification**\n\n- Default build: output identical to the single-rank run for `P` in {2, 3, 4, 7, 8} and `n` in {1, 2, 3, 5, 17, 64, 100, 257}. Validation passes in every case.\n- Contraction-off build: identical to the default build for the same grid.\n\n**Performance (this 256-thread machine)**\n\n| n | Original | P=1 | P=8 | P=16 | P=32 | P=64 | P=128 |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 2048 (ms) | 2145 | 781 | 185 | 137 | 101 | — | — |\n| 4096 (ms) | — | 6231 | — | 741 | — | 257 | 923 |\n\nThe 128-rank run is slower than 64 ranks. I did not investigate; it may be oversubscription on this box or per-step broadcast latency.\n\n**Limitations**\n\n- Each rank still holds the full n×n matrix, so memory per rank does not shrink with more ranks.\n- `output.txt` in the repo was modified during the session. I did not write to it."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":868,"cache_read_input_tokens":110467,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":868},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0a9aedfe-cb90-4357-9581-bb2bb5a92ab6","uuid":"dac0d21f-dd4a-47c5-beb0-c19695b958d2","timestamp":"2026-10-13T10:06:46.521Z","request_id":"req_011Cfz3r5ejV6UYyxdt8L1rw"}
